title: Direct Judgement Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Peifeng Wang, Austin Xu, Yilun Zhou, Caiming Xiong, Shafiq Joty
paper_type_zh: 基础评审器偏好数据构造研究
best_for_zh: 从异质评测标注构建可复用大语言模型评审器或评审器奖励信号的读者。
one_line: DJPO builds three complementary DPO pair types to train generalized LLM judges from critiques, direct decisions, and response deductions.
DJPO 构造三类互补的 DPO 样本对，从批评、直接决策和回答反推训练可泛化的大语言模型评审器。
why: It turns judgment labels and generated critiques into structured preference data that train a judge to evaluate, explain, and understand responses.
inclusion_reason: It specifies how heterogeneous evaluation annotations and generated traces become three distinct preference-pair types consumed by judge-model training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate, filter, and supply feedback for model training, yet many are trained by supervised imitation on small, narrow evaluation datasets. Such a judge may learn to reproduce a correct label without learning why it is correct, may fail on a new evaluation format, and has little exposure to incorrect candidate judgments. These limitations weaken its value as a reusable source of reward or data curation.

The paper asks how to construct preference data for a broadly capable judge rather than only train a model to emit ratings. It samples multiple candidate evaluations and uses agreement with a ground-truth judgment to create positives and negatives. It then adds three complementary learning views: explain the judgment with a critique, state the judgment directly, and infer the judged response from a correct evaluation. The aim is to train one consumer that can reason about evaluations, not merely mimic labels.

大语言模型评审器越来越多地被用于评估、过滤和为模型训练提供反馈，但其中许多只在小型、狭窄的评测数据集上进行监督模仿训练。这样的评审器可能学会复现正确标签，却不了解标签为何正确；它可能在新的评测格式上失败，也很少接触错误的候选判断。这些限制削弱了它作为可复用奖励或数据筛选来源的价值。

论文要回答的是：如何为具有广泛能力的评审器构造偏好数据，而不是只训练一个模型输出分数。它采样多个候选评测，并使用它们与真实判断的一致性来构造正负样本。随后加入三种互补的学习视角：用批评解释判断，直接陈述判断，以及从正确评测反推出被评回答。目标是训练一个能够推理评测的消费者，而不只是模仿标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DJPO treats a judgment label as a seed for several distinct preference records. A teacher generates a critique and final decision; if the decision matches the annotated ground truth, the full trace is preferred, otherwise it is rejected. Removing the critique from the same record yields a direct-outcome pair that concentrates the signal on the final judgment. Reversing the task yields a deduction pair in which the real judged response is preferred over a weaker model's reconstruction.

These are not redundant rephrasings. The critique record trains explanatory reasoning, the direct record prevents the long critique from diluting outcome tokens, and the deduction record forces the judge to connect a judgment to the response content that earned it. Mixing them creates a multi-task preference-data consumer. The design keeps ground truth at the point of selection but allows generated traces to supply richer contrastive supervision than an annotation alone.

DJPO 将一个判断标签视为若干不同偏好记录的种子。教师生成批评和最终决策；如果决策与已标注的真实判断一致，完整轨迹被设为入选，否则被设为拒绝。从同一记录中移除批评，就得到直接结果样本对，使信号集中到最终判断上。反转任务则得到反推样本对，其中真实被评回答优于较弱模型的重构回答。

这些并不是冗余的改写。批评记录训练解释性推理，直接记录防止冗长批评稀释结果 token，反推记录迫使评审器将判断与获得该判断的回答内容联系起来。混合它们形成一个多任务偏好数据消费者。该设计在选择环节保留真实标签，同时让生成轨迹提供比单个标注更丰富的对比监督。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors assemble human- and model-annotated evaluation datasets across single rating, pairwise comparison, and classification. They preserve available rubrics or write aligned rubrics when needed. Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct samples 20 critique-and-judgment outputs per input at temperature 0.7. Matching the final judgment to the ground truth labels a candidate positive; disagreement labels it negative, forming critique preference pairs. Removing the critique produces standard-judgment pairs with the same correctness test.

For response deduction, the model receives a protocol, input, and correct evaluation and must reconstruct the original response. The true original response is positive and a Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct deduction is negative. The curation balances label distributions and mixes 680K pairs at 70 percent critique, 15 percent direct judgment, and 15 percent deduction. DPO together with SFT trains 8B, 12B, and 70B instruction models; all three pair types are ablated separately.

作者汇集了覆盖单项评分、成对比较和分类的人类标注与模型标注评测数据集。他们保留可获得的评分准则，并在需要时撰写对齐的准则。Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 以 0.7 的温度针对每个输入采样 20 个批评和判断输出。最终判断与真实标签一致时，该候选被标为正样本；不一致时被标为负样本，从而形成批评偏好对。移除批评后得到标准判断对，并使用相同的正确性检验。

对于回答反推，模型接收准则、输入和正确评测，并必须重构原始回答。真实原始回答是正样本，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的反推结果是负样本。数据构造平衡标签分布，并以 70% 批评、15% 直接判断和 15% 反推混合 680K 个样本对。DPO 与 SFT 一起训练 8B、12B 和 70B 指令模型；三类样本对都被单独消融。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates seven pairwise, four single-rating, and two classification benchmarks. It reports that the 8B judge has stronger aggregate pairwise performance than GPT-4o and specialized judge baselines, while the 70B judge exceeds the next strongest listed 70B pairwise-only baseline by nearly two percent in aggregate. The judges are top two on six of seven pairwise benchmarks and also handle ties in Auto-J better than comparison models. On MetaCritique, the 70B model records 93.10 precision, 70.54 recall, and 77.60 F1 for critique quality.

The ablation connects the broad result to the three-record mixture. Removing any task reduces overall coverage; direct judgment gives sizable pairwise gains, while response deduction contributes to pairwise and classification performance even if it can slightly reduce single-rating performance. In a downstream experiment, the 70B judge scores generator outputs for UltraFeedback so that the highest score becomes a positive response and the lowest a negative response for another DPO run. This demonstrates that the constructed judge can itself become a training-data producer.

论文评测了七个成对比较、四个单项评分和两个分类基准。它报告，8B 评审器的成对比较综合表现强于 GPT-4o 和专门的评审器基线，而 70B 评审器在综合表现上比列出的下一个最强 70B 仅成对比较基线高近两个百分点。评审器在七个成对基准中的六个进入前二，并且比比较模型更好地处理了 Auto-J 中的平局。在 MetaCritique 上，70B 模型的批评质量精确率为 93.10、召回率为 70.54、F1 为 77.60。

消融将广泛结果与三类记录的混合联系起来。移除任何任务都会降低整体覆盖；直接判断带来显著的成对比较增益，而回答反推即使可能略微降低单项评分表现，也有助于成对和分类表现。在下游实验中，70B 评审器为 UltraFeedback 的生成器输出打分，使最高分成为正回答、最低分成为负回答，用于另一轮 DPO。这表明构造出的评审器本身可以成为训练数据生产者。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty lies in changing the task shape of judge preference data, not simply scaling a DPO corpus. A single annotation is transformed into critique, outcome, and inverse-response records, each with a different positive/negative contract. This preserves the same judgment anchor while exposing different failure modes: incorrect reasoning, incorrect final decision, and a weak understanding of what content a decision refers to.

The response-deduction task is particularly distinctive because it asks the judge to use an evaluation as evidence about the evaluated text. Combined with the direct judgment task, it avoids treating a fluent critique as sufficient proof of a correct outcome. The result is a foundation-judge recipe whose output can be reused as a reward model and as a source of downstream preference pairs, creating a documented bridge from evaluator data to training data.

新意在于改变评审器偏好数据的任务形状，而不只是扩大 DPO 语料。一个单独标注被转化为批评、结果和反向回答记录，每种记录都有不同的正负契约。这保留了同一个判断锚点，同时暴露不同失败模式：错误推理、错误最终决策，以及对一个决策指向何种内容的理解不足。

回答反推任务尤其独特，因为它要求评审器将一个评测用作关于被评文本的证据。结合直接判断任务，它避免把流畅的批评当成正确结果的充分证明。结果是一套基础评审器方案，其输出可以复用为奖励模型和下游偏好对来源，形成从评估器数据到训练数据的有文档支撑的桥梁。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The pipeline requires human or model annotated judgments and may need new annotations as the systems being evaluated change. It focuses on judging complete responses, not assigning process-level rewards to partial reasoning traces. Generating a critique before the final decision costs more inference time than a scalar classification reward model. Finally, candidate quality depends on the ground-truth labels and teacher traces used in curation, so a broad dataset mixture does not eliminate label, rubric, or teacher bias.
该流程需要人类或模型标注的判断，并且随着被评系统变化，可能需要新的标注。它聚焦于评估完整回答，而不是为部分推理轨迹分配过程级奖励。在给出最终决策前生成批评，比标量分类奖励模型消耗更多推理时间。最后，候选质量依赖于构造中使用的真实标签和教师轨迹，因此广泛的数据集混合并不能消除标签、准则或教师偏差。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a team needs a judge that will later score, filter, or create training records across more than one evaluation format. It provides an auditable way to turn judgment annotations into three complementary DPO consumers and to test which task types are necessary. Before applying it, check rubric compatibility across sources, sample enough teacher candidates to obtain both positive and negative outputs, preserve label provenance, and separately evaluate the judge in the downstream data-construction role rather than assuming benchmark judge accuracy guarantees good reward data.
当团队需要一个之后会跨越多种评测格式进行打分、过滤或创建训练记录的评审器时，可以使用这项工作。它提供一种可审计的方式，将判断标注转化为三种互补的 DPO 消费者，并检验哪些任务类型是必要的。在应用之前，应检查各来源之间的准则兼容性，采样足够多的教师候选以获得正负输出，保留标签来源，并单独评估评审器在下游数据构造角色中的表现，而不要假定基准评审准确率必然保证奖励数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3.1–3.3 as a curation specification: the key question is which output is treated as positive and negative for each task, not DPO alone. Then examine the ablation in Section 5.3 and the downstream DPO construction in Section 5.4, because together they establish both the internal value of the mixture and its external use as a data producer. A reproduction should record the source rubric, teacher model, candidate count, correctness-match rule, task mixture, label balancing, and whether critique text is retained; each changes the judge's eventual training surface.
应将第 3.1 至 3.3 节作为数据构造规范阅读：关键问题是每项任务中哪个输出被视为正样本和负样本，而不只是 DPO 本身。随后查看第 5.3 节消融和第 5.4 节下游 DPO 构造，因为它们共同建立了混合在内部的价值，以及作为数据生产者的外部用途。复现时应记录来源准则、教师模型、候选数量、正确性匹配规则、任务混合、标签平衡和是否保留批评文本；每一项都会改变评审器最终的训练表面。
